headline: BDT 1000 crore Padma river protection dam at risk due to erosion in Shariatpur
summary: An under-construction river protection dam worth BDT 1000 crore along the Padma River in Jajira, Shariatpur, is facing severe erosion. This has forced residents to abandon their homes as the critical infrastructure is jeopardized.
details: An under-construction river protection dam along the Padma River in Jajira, Shariatpur, has been hit by severe erosion. This critical infrastructure, valued at BDT 1000 crore, is now at significant risk.

The ongoing erosion has forced numerous local residents to abandon their homes, seeking safety as the riverbank continues to recede. Their livelihoods and properties are directly threatened by the relentless river action.

headline: 53 BCL-YCL-Mohila League activists detained from a house in Dhaka
summary: Police have reportedly detained 53 activists from a residence in the capital. The individuals are said to be affiliated with Chhatra League, Jubo League, and Mohila League.
details: Fifty-three activists reportedly associated with Bangladesh Chhatra League (BCL), Jubo League, and Mohila League have been detained from a residence in Dhaka. The detentions occurred in the capital city, though the specific location within Dhaka was not immediately specified.
The individuals were taken into custody from a single house. Further details regarding the reasons for their detention and the charges, if any, are yet to be released by authorities.
